title: ID0413655-DC/SI-D/FR-[MP/R6 170002075] AC Socket always in used condition (C1)
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: The charger on SCB seems to use the AC socket but in reality this socket is not used. The AC flag is always in use condition while the socket is not used
Solution:
yyyy-mm-dd:
Handover ES to NOC: 10.04.2025

additional_info.subject: Notes for L3:
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause :
NA
Problem Description :
The charger on SCB seems to use the AC socket but in reality this socket is not used. The AC flag is always in use condition while the socket is not used
Action Performed (L2) :
Log analysis. Found that no charging session was performed since 1 month. Last session was carried out on 21st Feb (refer logs mentioned in timeline). Still the symbol of AC socket is in used condition on SCB. Found
Modbus error of Meter_BC6_AC_Income
in error flags.
Charger SW Version:
V6.0.3
Reason for Handover (L3) :
Need to check further if its issue with SCB or hardware issue.
Log analysis with timestamp :
NA
Action Required
Action by HQ : Deeper analysis
Attachement
: refer notes in timeline.

additional_info.subject: Handover ES to NOC
additional_info.body:
I rebooted via SSH the EcoG KF11 and on SCB the AC socket is available and not in “in use condition” anymore. Furthermore, I checked on AWS and there has not been any charging session on AC socket since September 2024 (only one attempt on 21.02.2025 but at the same time as a reboot request).
Regarding the error flag:
Meter_BC6_AC_Income
PLC
DEVICE
true
Modbus Error
The PAC income meter is not reachable:
Firstly, it has to be clarified with the RC if the BC6 meter is actually installed on the charger, otherwise please remove it from the SCB configuration.
If it is installed, an onsite visit is required to check the ETH cable to the BC6.
Handover as no further action from ES is required.
